propositions: The plan-writing guide documents criteria but omits the 15 registered coaching moves, leaving authors without lookup when coached on specific techniques.

The five highest-frequency coaching moves (specification-by-example at 150 hits, plan-the-verification at 96, riskiest-assumption-test at 51, state-attestation-evidence at 41, propagate-to-children at 22) are not named in the guide.
The state-attestation-evidence move's [operator-attested] tag is absent from the guide despite being part of the coaching output.
A new 'Responding to coaching moves' section must be added to the guide, ordered by field frequency, with technique descriptions and before/after examples for the top five moves.
Move names in the guide must exactly match the coach_moves.py MOVE_REGISTRY spelling to enable cross-validation.
